sentences.en: This is an iHeart Podcast, Guaranteed Human.
sentences.zh: 这是一个iHeart播客，保证由真人制作。

sentences.en: I've been approaching my health really differently this year.
sentences.zh: 今年我对待健康的方式有了很大的改变。

sentences.en: I used to be really focused on maximizing and doing more.
sentences.zh: 过去我总是专注于追求极致，做更多的事情。

sentences.en: And now I'm just realizing that if I listen to what my body needs, I perform way better.
sentences.zh: 但现在我意识到，如果我倾听身体的需求，我的表现反而会更好。

sentences.en: And that's why I am obsessed with my Whoop.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我如此痴迷于我的Whoop设备。

sentences.en: Truly, you guys, you know I'm such a data and information driven person.
sentences.zh: 说真的，你们知道我是一个非常依赖数据和信息的人。

sentences.en: And I love opening my Whoop app and seeing how my sleep, my stress, my strain is correlating with my mood, with my running performance, with how I'm just feeling day to day.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢打开Whoop应用程序，看看我的睡眠、压力和身体负荷如何与我的情绪、跑步表现以及我日常的感受相关联。

sentences.en: I'm not an elite athlete by any means, but I do really benefit.
sentences.zh: 我绝不是什么精英运动员，但我确实从中受益匪浅。

sentences.en: And I also just really enjoy knowing more about my body.
sentences.zh: 而且我也真的很喜欢更多地了解自己的身体。

sentences.en: And Whoop also gives me these actionable, personalized insights that have made me more intentional and meant that I make smarter decisions day to day
sentences.zh: Whoop还为我提供了这些可操作的、个性化的见解，让我变得更有目标感，也意味着我在日常生活中能做出更明智的决定，

sentences.en: about what I need rather than just putting my foot on the gas and just going, going, going, going.
sentences.zh: 清楚自己需要什么，而不是一味地踩油门，不停地向前冲。

sentences.zh: 新用户在订阅会员之前，可以先通过Whoop的30天免费试用进行体验。

sentences.en: French taste.

sentences.en: Hello, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: I'm Gemma Spake, and welcome back to The Psychology of Your 20s, the podcast where we talk through the biggest changes, moments, and transitions of our 20s,
sentences.zh: 我是Gemma Spake，欢迎回到《你20多岁的心理学》，在这个播客里，我们探讨20多岁时经历的最大变化、时刻和转型，

sentences.en: and what they mean for our psychology.
sentences.zh: 以及它们对我们心理意味着什么。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到节目。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到播客。

sentences.en: It is so great to have you here, back for a little special edition bonus episode, talking about some crazy news.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你们能回来，参加这一期特别的加更集，聊聊一些疯狂的新闻。

sentences.en: I'm sure all of you, I hope you guys know this by now, but The Psychology of Your 20s is officially on Netflix.
sentences.zh: 我相信你们所有人，我希望你们现在已经知道了，《你20多岁的心理学》正式上线Netflix了。

sentences.en: All of this happened so faSt.
sentences.zh: 这一切发生得太快了。

sentences.en: I didn't get to tell you guys the story.
sentences.zh: 我还没来得及告诉你们这个故事。

sentences.en: I tell you guys everything.
sentences.zh: 我什么都跟你们说。

sentences.en: I didn't get to share the juicy details, and I want to share the juicy details, and I didn't really get to address how this is going to change things for the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我还没来得及分享那些精彩的细节，我想分享，而且我还没来得及谈谈这对播客意味着什么改变。

sentences.en: Spoiler alert, it's not really going to change much, but this is just such a monumental moment for The Psychology of Your 20s, and each of you have been there for,
sentences.zh: 剧透一下，其实不会有太大改变，但这对于《你20多岁的心理学》来说是一个里程碑式的时刻，你们每个人都陪伴着我，

sentences.en: whether you've been here for a month, whether you've been here for almost five years,
sentences.zh: 无论你是听了一个月，还是已经听了快五年了，

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: It just feels weird for something so huge to happen and to not give you guys a behind-the-scenes look at, I don't know, what it means to get a Netflix show,
sentences.zh: 发生这么大的事情却不给你们看看幕后花絮，感觉怪怪的，比如，我不知道，获得一个Netflix节目意味着什么，

sentences.en: like what that process looks like and just how I've been feeling as well.
sentences.zh: 比如那个过程是什么样的，以及我自己的感受。

sentences.en: It's obviously a huge personal change as well as a professional change and a change for us.
sentences.zh: 这显然是一个巨大的个人转变，也是一个职业转变，对我们来说也是一个转变。

sentences.en: So yeah, this Sunday, this bonus episode, I thought I'd just sit down back where it all began, in bed, in my house, and dish and tell you guys what's been happening
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这个周日，这期加更集，我想回到一切开始的地方，在床上，在我的家里，跟你们聊聊发生了什么，

sentences.en: and how this came to be.
sentences.zh: 以及这一切是如何实现的。

sentences.en: So yes, if you didn't know, if this is the first time you're hearing this,
sentences.zh: 所以是的，如果你还不知道，如果你是第一次听到这个消息，

sentences.en: The Psychology of Your 20s is officially a Netflix podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 《你20多岁的心理学》正式成为Netflix播客了。

sentences.en: Let me get one thing out of the way.
sentences.zh: 让我先说明一件事。

sentences.en: That does not mean we're going anywhere.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着我们要离开这里。

sentences.en: The only thing it changes is basically that our episodes are no longer on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 唯一改变的是，我们的节目不再在YouTube上发布了。

sentences.en: Our video episodes are no longer on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 我们的视频节目不再在YouTube上发布了。

sentences.en: But if you only ever listen to audio, this is basically just a bonus for you.
sentences.zh: 但如果你一直只听音频，这对你来说基本上只是一个福利。

sentences.en: Now you can watch it on the most popular streaming platform in the world, but you can also listen to it on Spotify, listen to it on Apple, wherever you are listening right now,
sentences.zh: 现在你可以在全球最受欢迎的流媒体平台上观看它，但你也可以在Spotify、Apple上收听，无论你现在在哪里收听，

sentences.en: and nothing really changes.
sentences.zh: 其实什么都没变。

sentences.en: Another thing to address,
sentences.zh: 还有一件事要说明，

sentences.en: I have had a lot of messages from people in Australia or in Thailand or in Italy being like, I can't see it.
sentences.zh: 我收到了很多来自澳大利亚、泰国或意大利的朋友发来的信息，说：我看不到。

sentences.en: That's because as of right now, it is only in the US and Canada.
sentences.zh: 那是因为目前它只在美国和加拿大上线。

sentences.en: And I don't really know what their plans are to extend it, to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我真的不知道他们有什么扩展计划。

sentences.en: I'm kind of out of the loop.
sentences.zh: 我有点消息闭塞。

sentences.en: But as soon as that changes, I will let you guys know.
sentences.zh: 但一旦情况有变，我会第一时间通知你们。

sentences.en: We are still posting like clips and stuff.
sentences.zh: 我们仍然会发布一些片段之类的东西。

sentences.en: So if you want to see what the new studio looks like, it's pretty cool.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你想看看新演播室是什么样子的，它真的很酷。

sentences.en: You can find that on Instagram and we're still posting like some shorts to YouTube.
sentences.zh: 你可以在Instagram上找到它，我们仍然会发布一些短视频到YouTube上。

sentences.en: But basically, nothing much is changing.
sentences.zh: 但基本上，没什么大变化。

sentences.en: This is just some, just an extra way of like, yeah, of the podcast being distributed and being able to connect with you guys.
sentences.zh: 这只是，只是播客分发的一种额外方式，也是能够与你们建立联系的一种方式。

sentences.en: I absolutely love our set.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢我们的布景。

sentences.en: I think it is beautiful.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它很美。

sentences.en: There's so many like little personal details in it as well that feel really special to me.
sentences.zh: 里面还有很多小小的个人细节，对我来说感觉非常特别。

sentences.en: You guys don't care about that.
sentences.zh: 你们可能不在乎这些。

sentences.en: I want to tell you the story of how this freaking happened because I don't,
sentences.zh: 我想告诉你们这到底是怎么发生的，因为我不知道，

sentences.en: I've never heard anyone talk about what it means to be on Netflix and like how people approach you with that.
sentences.zh: 我从来没听过有人谈论上Netflix意味着什么，以及人们是如何就此与你接洽的。

sentences.en: How do you find out that that's going to be something that happened?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么发现这件事会发生的？

sentences.en: So let me take you back, actually not very far to like October last year when I was still living in Sydney.
sentences.zh: 让我带你们回溯一下，其实没过多久，回到去年十月，当时我还住在悉尼。

sentences.en: This was very out of the blue.
sentences.zh: 这非常突然。

sentences.en: I'm just going to make that super clear.
sentences.zh: 我只想把这一点说得非常清楚。

sentences.en: I feel like that's very obvious from how I've been speaking about it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得从我谈论它的方式中，这一点很明显。

sentences.en: I had no clue this was happening.
sentences.zh: 我根本不知道这会发生。

sentences.en: To be honest,
sentences.zh: 老实说，

sentences.en: I have been a little bit hesitant about doing video podcasts.
sentences.zh: 我对做视频播客一直有点犹豫。

sentences.en: I always said, you know, the podcast is audio only.
sentences.zh: 我总是说，你知道，播客只是音频。

sentences.en: I was very uncomfortable in front of the camera.
sentences.zh: 我在镜头前很不自在。

sentences.en: This was like my preferred format, just my voice.
sentences.zh: 这是我喜欢的形式，只有我的声音。

sentences.en: You know, maybe it's because when I was like a kid, somebody said I had a face for radio and I really internalized that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，也许是因为我小时候，有人说我长了一张适合广播的脸，我真的把这句话记在心里了。

sentences.en: But you guys know, I kind of started a YouTube and I started posting the episodes there and I was really getting into the swing of it.
sentences.zh: 但你们知道，我还是开了个YouTube频道，开始在那里发布节目，我真的开始进入状态了。

sentences.en: I felt very motivated by it.
sentences.zh: 我对此感到非常有动力。

sentences.en: I was, it just is nice to learn a new set of skills, right?
sentences.zh: 我，学习一套新技能感觉真好，对吧？

sentences.en: And I feel like I've been doing this for a while now.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我已经做这个有一段时间了。

sentences.en: I wanted to try something else and kind of take it in a new direction.
sentences.zh: 我想尝试点别的，换个方向。

sentences.en: So I was kind of posting on YouTube,
sentences.zh: 所以我当时在YouTube上发布视频，

sentences.en: no views.
sentences.zh: 没什么观看量。

sentences.en: It really felt like when I first started the podcast and I would like, nobody was really listening.
sentences.zh: 感觉真的很像我刚开始做播客的时候，没什么人听。

sentences.en: It felt very reminiscent of that.
sentences.zh: 感觉非常怀旧。

sentences.en: And then one day I get this call from my agent, my podcast agent, who like takes care of all the business side of things.
sentences.zh: 然后有一天，我接到了我的经纪人，我的播客经纪人的电话，她负责处理所有的商务事宜。

sentences.en: Actually, I got a message and she was like,
sentences.zh: 其实，我收到了一条信息，她说，

sentences.en: hey, are you awake?
sentences.zh: 嘿，你醒了吗？

sentences.en: And I missed the message and I was like, yeah, what's up?
sentences.zh: 我错过了那条信息，然后我说，在呢，怎么了？

sentences.en: And she's like, I have to call you.
sentences.zh: 她说，我得给你打个电话。

sentences.en: I've got some news for you.
sentences.zh: 我有消息要告诉你。

sentences.en: And I was about to move to London in like the next two months.
sentences.zh: 当时我大概两个月后就要搬到伦敦了。

sentences.en: She lived in London.
sentences.zh: 她住在伦敦。

sentences.en: I was like, oh, this has to be something to do with maybe she's staying in London for longer because she was planning on moving.
sentences.zh: 我想，哦，这一定和她有关，也许她要在伦敦待更久，因为她当时正计划搬家。

sentences.en: Like, I don't know what's going on, but like it's a personal thing.
sentences.zh: 就像，我不知道发生了什么，但这是一件私事。

sentences.en: And so I call her that night and I'm like, hey, like what's going on?
sentences.zh: 那天晚上我给她打了电话，我说，嘿，怎么了？

sentences.en: You know, are you okay?
sentences.zh: 你知道，你还好吗？

sentences.en: Like what's happening in London?
sentences.zh: 伦敦发生了什么事？

sentences.en: You know, thinking that's what it was.
sentences.zh: 你知道，以为是那回事。

sentences.en: And she was like, you need to, you need to sit down.
sentences.zh: 她说，你需要，你需要坐下来。

sentences.en: I just got off the call, off the phone.
sentences.zh: 我刚挂了电话，

sentences.en: Like yesterday I got off the phone with somebody
sentences.zh: 昨天我刚和某人通完电话，

sentences.en: and I literally can't even, this is so crazy to me, but Netflix is interested in signing your podcast for a video deal.
sentences.zh: 我简直无法相信，这对我来说太疯狂了，但Netflix有兴趣签下你的播客做视频协议。

sentences.en: And my reaction to that was, that is not funny.
sentences.zh: 我的反应是，这不好笑。

sentences.en: Please don't joke with me like that.
sentences.zh: 请别跟我开这种玩笑。

sentences.en: And she was like, no, that is absolutely what is happening.
sentences.zh: 她说，不，这绝对是真的。

sentences.en: No promises, but they're interested.
sentences.zh: 不敢保证，但他们确实感兴趣。

sentences.en: And this is moving really faSt.
sentences.zh: 而且进展非常快。

sentences.en: Bear in mind, this was in October.
sentences.zh: 记住，这是在十月。

sentences.en: It's January as I'm recording this.
sentences.zh: 我录音的时候已经是这一年的的一月了。

sentences.en: And I was like, okay, well, let them know I'm keen.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，让他们知道我有意向。

sentences.en: Like, I'm not going to say no.
sentences.zh: 我不会拒绝的。

sentences.en: Let them know I'm totally down to do that.
sentences.zh: 让他们知道我完全愿意做这件事。

sentences.en: And I told four people.
sentences.zh: 我告诉了四个人。

sentences.en: I told, obviously Tom, my boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 我告诉了Tom，我的男朋友。

sentences.en: I told my dad, but I said, don't tell anybody else.
sentences.zh: 我告诉了我爸爸，但我说，别告诉其他人。

sentences.en: I knew he was going to tell my mom, but I was like, don't tell anyone else.
sentences.zh: 我知道他会告诉妈妈，但我说，别告诉任何人。

sentences.en: And I called my best friend and was like, and she was with another friend of ours.
sentences.zh: 我给最好的朋友打了电话，当时她和我们的另一个朋友在一起。

sentences.en: So I ended up telling them and being like, this might not happen.
sentences.zh: 所以我最后告诉了她们，并说，这可能不会发生。

sentences.en: Don't tell anybody.
sentences.zh: 别告诉任何人。

sentences.en: I don't,
sentences.zh: 我不想，

sentences.en: I'm so superstitious about not talking about things until they actually happen.
sentences.zh: 我非常迷信，在事情真正发生之前不谈论它。

sentences.en: I didn't want to jinx it.
sentences.zh: 我不想乌鸦嘴。

sentences.en: I didn't want people to know.
sentences.zh: 我不想让别人知道。

sentences.en: I didn't want it to be like, this was out there and that meant that it could get taken away.
sentences.zh: 我不想让它变得好像，这事传出去了，意味着它可能会被取消。

sentences.en: And then that night I literally sat down and I was like, what, how do I respond to this?
sentences.zh: 那天晚上我真的坐下来，我想，我该怎么回应这个？

sentences.en: I better just do more, more work.
sentences.zh: 我最好多做点工作。

sentences.en: This is very pathological for me, but I was like, oh my God, I, well, this is going to happen.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说非常病态，但我当时想，天哪，我，好吧，这要发生了。

sentences.en: I better prove that I'm, that I deserve it.
sentences.zh: 我最好证明我，我配得上它。

sentences.en: I better, better work tonight, but I was going to clock off for the evening, but I better get back on my laptop and tippy tappy away.
sentences.zh: 我最好，最好今晚工作，我本来打算晚上收工的，但我最好回到笔记本电脑前敲敲打打。

sentences.en: And I actually, this is crazy.
sentences.zh: 我真的，这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: I actually made the, if you follow me on Instagram, the psychology of skinny top post, which crazy, that is like my most successful post of all time.
sentences.zh: 我真的做了那个，如果你关注我的Instagram，那个关于“瘦子心理学”的帖子，疯狂的是，那是我有史以来最成功的帖子。

sentences.en: It has 8 million views.
sentences.zh: 它有800万次观看。

sentences.en: Wild.
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了。

sentences.en: But that literally, that, that is how you, like, if you want to go back and look at timeline,
sentences.zh: 但那真的，那，那就是你，如果你想回去看看时间线，

sentences.en: I, maybe I should go and look at it.
sentences.zh: 也许我应该去看看。

sentences.en: That is the date that I found out, the date that I posted that.
sentences.zh: 那就是我发现的那一天，我发布那条帖子的日期。

sentences.en: And then I heard nothing.
sentences.zh: 然后我就没再听到任何消息了。

sentences.en: I didn't hear anything for like,
sentences.zh: 大概有那么，

sentences.en: I would say a month.
sentences.zh: 我想是一个月吧，我都没听到任何动静。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, this isn't happening.
